# HOTFIX 2026-08-01: authlib + validators are REQUIRED deps of weaviate-client
# 4.22.0 that the generated requirements.txt was missing, so `uv pip sync
# requirements.txt --system` produced an image where `import weaviate` died on
# `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'validators'`. agno masks that as
# "Weaviate is not installed. Install using 'pip install weaviate-client'."
# (agno/vectordb/weaviate/weaviate.py:19), which sent the first diagnosis the
# wrong way — weaviate-client 4.22.0 WAS installed. Because session.py imports
# Weaviate at module scope, this crash-looped agentos-api on boot.
# Root cause of the omission: scripts/generate_requirements.sh runs
# `uv pip compile` WITHOUT `--python-platform linux`, so the resolve happens
# against the Windows host. Remove these two pins only when that script is
# fixed and a clean linux-target recompile carries them itself.
